description: Project coordinator leading the BRIDGE-AI consortium and responsible for project management, innovation coordination, dissemination, and exploitation of project results across all work packages.

name: Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology
role: Academic Institution, Innovation Hub, Research & Capacity Building
description: Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology (JKUAT) is a leading public university in Kenya specializing in science, technology, engineering, agriculture, and innovation. Through JHUB Africa, JKUAT supports research commercialization, entrepreneurship, digital innovation, AI adoption, and sustainable agricultural technologies. Within the BRIDGE-AI Kenya ecosystem, JKUAT plays a key role in Smart Mushroom research, stakeholder engagement, training, and capacity building.
ecosystem_impact: JKUAT strengthens Kenya's AI and agricultural innovation ecosystem by connecting researchers, students, startups, SMEs, farmers, government agencies, and industry partners. Through research, technology transfer, incubation, and digital innovation programs such as JHUB Africa, the university accelerates the adoption of AI-powered smart farming solutions and supports sustainable agricultural development.

name: Universidad Politécnica de Madrid

name: University of Sousse
